scope: One desktop 1280x800 dark real-time native-RAF journey per game in Chromium and WebKit. Actual keyboard and local role controls; natural game end, result semantics/focus, Space restart and fresh-run input effects. No clock/game-state/render overrides, retries, camera, physical controller, phone or assistive-technology qualification.
limits: Conventional controls are offered when the input manifest declares keyboard support or an on-page role layout declares the control; other cells are explicitly not-offered.
Gamepad/phone physical paths, heard assistive-technology announcements and complete neutral-release qualification remain unverified.
Prior completed Spellcaster action/aim evidence is separately retained; not relabeled as a current-SDK rerun.
